title: Token Thermodynamics: temperature spectroscopy of a language model's next-token distribution
description: Softmax sampling in a language model is exactly the Boltzmann distribution. This repository computes the resulting thermodynamics of the next-token distribution from one forward pass, gives a closed form for the heat-capacity peak in terms of the logit gap and the vocabulary size, tests it across 12 models spanning a 976-fold range of vocabulary size, shows that entropy turning points lie on the rising flank of the heat capacity, reports a pre-registered test in which sampling at a temperature predicted from the melting temperature failed, and records the falsified hypotheses alongside the results that survived.
